description: This file defines a helper class for processing FreeMarker templates, providing methods to process templates into strings or write them directly to files.

classes.name: FreemarkerHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to process FreeMarker templates into strings or files.

methods.description: Processes a FreeMarker template and writes the output to a specified file.
